chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Bubbles as father figure: keys and psychology
summary: Bubbles gave Green keys to unlock steps, philosophised like a psychologist, and told them they had to perform like Buck and Bubbles.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: And he gave me about three or four keys, as he called them. He called it keys to -- I asked him, "What is keys?" And he said, "Well, keys finds the locks", you know. And I used to be full of laughter every time -- I loved the way he talk, you know, when he talk, you know, he caused happiness

because he was a comedian, see.

And he had a way of talking, you see. But he was very fatherly, you see, as I said before. I mean he --
Did he talk in metaphors like you do so often?

No, he has -- he mostly philosophized, you see. He's kind of psychology -- he talked psychology to a person, where you can make -- you use your own intelligence, you see. (Recording interruption) See, and once he observes that your intelligence is coming through, he'll request -- he'll repeat the question. He'll ask you to ask him the question, the way -- what would your answer be, just to see how you would answer.

And if your answer accordingly to his psychology, then he would be pleased, and he'd say, 'Now, that's better,' you see. That's -- he wanted us to be men, you see. And he said, 'You know, Buck and Bubbles -- it's about the only styles up here in Harlem now. I mean if you're going to follow in our footsteps, you're going to have to actually be able to perform like Buck and Bubbles.

'Well, you can't hold nothing out, you know. You've got to put it all there, together. Let the people see it. Let them hear you and this, that and the other.' And he said, 'In fact, talking to some people, I've got a place to take you kids and -- where he can take you through the paces, you know.
